The fix keeps the most recently ingested version of each txn_id, assumed to be the authoritative record, and then applies the POSTED filter, so a later reversal also removes the transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC, CASE WHEN status = 'REVERSED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) d WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
